entities.title: A high-score table on icelander.net/games
entities.summary: Every other arcade game has a server-checked high-score table on the multiplayer page; Neon Snake keeps only each player's own best, in their browser.
acceptanceCriteria: A finished game can be submitted and the Worker replays it before recording the score, as Rally's does.
site/games.json in icelander.net gets a scores entry for the game.
